how_to_apply: Fill in the Google form at https://forms.gle/L7dgf5r1ti8mLtuJ8 by 22 November 2026, till 1:00 p.m.
Complete the application in the prescribed format printed in the notice (Format for Application) and prepare your Bio-data.
Report in person at Conference Hall No 2, Auditorium, AIIMS Bathinda on 23 November 2026 between 09:00 a.m. and 10:30 a.m.
Submit the filled application form and Bio-data on the day of the interview, with all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies.

The prescribed application format asks for the post applied for, the Advertisement File No. and date, personal details, category (UR/OBC/SC/ST), addresses, email, phone, qualifications from High School onwards, post-qualification experience with duties, the joining period needed, a passport size photo, a Yes/No confirmation of having read the salary description, two references with email ID and contact number, and a signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute and the Project
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bathinda is located at Jodhpur Romana, Mandi Dabwali Road, Bathinda, Punjab-151001. This walk-in is issued by its Department of Anaesthesiology for the project entitled "Strengthening of Palliative Care Services in Bathinda". The funding agency named in the notice is the Cipla Foundation, and the rules and regulations of AIIMS Bathinda and/or the Cipla Foundation will apply to the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post of Palliative Care Doctor on a purely temporary basis under the project. The essential qualification is "MBBS With state valid state medical council Registration", and the essential experience is a minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a health care setup. The age limit is "As per the government rules"; the notice prints no figure and no relaxation table. Experience of working in palliative care. Excellent proficiency in English, both written and verbal. Good proficiency in Hindi and local languages. Willing to travel to visit patients at home care setup. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. The Palliative Care Doctor gets ₹ 1,00,000/- per month (consolidated). The notice states that the salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits, and that it is based on the experience, qualifications and skill set of the candidates. If the project is stalled or postponed due to unforeseen circumstances, the salary may be delayed or stopped for that period. The tenure is till 31st March 2027; it can be extended according to the need of the project and the performance of the candidate. The position is purely temporary/contractual, co-terminus with the project, and the candidate will have no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Bathinda or the funding agency, or continuation in any other project. The appointment may be cancelled at any time for misconduct, unsatisfactory work, if the candidate is later found ineligible, or on withdrawal of funds by the funding agency.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bathinda Palliative Care Doctor Job Description
content_sections.text: Job profile: candidates are expected to do field visits as and when required as per the demand of the project. The roles and responsibilities printed in the notice are: To take ward rounds daily. Independently carry out a comprehensive patient assessment and develop a medical management plan. Present the ward round to a senior palliative care physician. Ensure that inputs of Specialist Palliative care physicians in the team are sought, taken, documented and implemented for patient care plans. Maintain up-to-date and accurate documentation of care in patient records, including electronic medical records. Independently carry out minor procedures at ward level like nasogastric tube insertion, urinary catheter insertion, wound management, etc. Keep up-to-date knowledge of the pharmacology of medications commonly used in palliative care. Provide clinical care to patients referred through external OPDs. Triage the patients seen in external OPDs for OPD consultation or admission at day care or home care registration as per the need. Visit patients at homecare as per the schedule and needs of the family/patient.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Fill in the Google form at https://forms.gle/L7dgf5r1ti8mLtuJ8 by 22 November 2026, till 1:00 p.m. Complete the application in the prescribed format printed in the notice (Format for Application) and prepare your Bio-data. Report in person at Conference Hall No 2, Auditorium, AIIMS Bathinda on 23 November 2026 between 09:00 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. Submit the filled application form and Bio-data on the day of the interview, with all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Aadhar Card. Two passport-size photographs. Application Form in the prescribed format (duly filled) and Bio-data. All educational and experience documents in original. One set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience. Eligibility qualification mark sheets, degrees and experience certificate. Qualifying degree registration with the statutory council (if applicable) and other relevant testimonials.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Reporting opens at 09:00 a.m. on 23 November 2026 and closes at 10:30 a.m.; no additional candidates will be entertained for the interview after that. The mode of selection is "Interview/ Written exam or both", held at Conference Hall No 2, Auditorium, AIIMS Bathinda. No TA/DA or any other allowances will be paid for attending the interview, including to SC/ST candidates.
